instruction: A candid outdoor wide shot of a grassy park. On the left, a large Black man in a black t-shirt (R1) and a bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R2) on the far right lean forward, watching a blue frisbee fly on the left. In the background, an Asian man in a red polo (R3) cheers with raised hands, flanked by a woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) and a woman with an afro in a red t-shirt (R6) on the far left. A woman in a dark blue t-shirt (R4) stands in the center-right foreground, leaning forward in anticipation. Bright daylight illuminates the green grass and background trees.
